evidence: Published category methods scoring curves retained products and retesting
why_it_compounds: Each new product adds a comparable observation to an existing measurement system
failure_condition: Methods drift silently or measured attributes do not change the purchase
transfer_to_recommended_business: Publish a robot-mower test bench and retain benchmark units before scaling categories

evidence: Membership affiliate commissions and endorsement licensing coexist with purchase and editorial policies
why_it_compounds: More than one aligned payer can fund costly evidence without selling rankings
failure_condition: Commercial licensing weakens perceived independence or membership keeps shrinking
transfer_to_recommended_business: Separate the test decision ranking and merchant commercial ledgers from day one

evidence: More than 30 million dollars expected yearly testing spend across 10000-plus products and services
why_it_compounds: Laboratories expertise and longitudinal records are hard to recreate
failure_condition: Fixed testing scope grows faster than member and donor funding
transfer_to_recommended_business: Choose one consequential method a small operator can execute credibly

evidence: Twelve-month price history target alerts frequent offer updates and timestamps
why_it_compounds: A one-time comparison becomes retained purchase intent and a proprietary time series
failure_condition: Alerts are noisy or offer matching and availability are unreliable
transfer_to_recommended_business: Store observed price and stock events and let buyers save a project threshold

evidence: Component filters automatic warnings complete part lists price history and shareable builds
why_it_compounds: Every saved build improves the value of the component graph and community examples
failure_condition: Compatibility coverage is incomplete or errors are costly
transfer_to_recommended_business: Model the whole garden project and required accessories rather than rank isolated products

mechanism: Canonical parts graph joined to creation software
evidence: Parts sets inventories price guide wanted lists and Studio design tool use the same identities
why_it_compounds: Design creates demand for exact parts while transactions and history improve the graph
failure_condition: Community governance fragments identities or the manufacturer closes access
transfer_to_recommended_business: A saved plan should emit a product and installation bill of materials

mechanism: Trust operations for expensive heterogeneous goods
evidence: Escrow proof of ownership dealer verification authentication and buyer protection
why_it_compounds: Assurance expands the geographic supply a buyer will consider
failure_condition: Fraud service and dispute cost exceed the take rate
transfer_to_recommended_business: For used or installed equipment qualify supplier condition ownership and serviceability

evidence: Retailer subscription technology data API and Deal Builder sit beside consumer stock search
why_it_compounds: Dealer workflow creates recurring revenue and fresher supply while reducing churn
failure_condition: Software is sold before buyer demand or does not improve retailer economics
transfer_to_recommended_business: Only add installer or dealer software after repeated qualified demand exists

evidence: Used-machinery inventory discovery and dealer software serve the same supply base
why_it_compounds: Better supplier operations improve inventory quality and buyer response
failure_condition: Listings become stale or fragmented and software does not become daily workflow
transfer_to_recommended_business: Land machinery should be a supplier operating system plus search not affiliate editorial

evidence: Collectors enter and correct exact physical releases; marketplace listings attach to those releases
why_it_compounds: Contributors get collection and transaction utility in return for maintaining the graph
failure_condition: Moderation cost rises or contributors lose trust and ownership
transfer_to_recommended_business: Invite expert corrections only where contributors receive attribution tools and useful saved records

evidence: Direct members email social creator collections advertising affiliate subscription and service products
why_it_compounds: The same expertise reaches users and buyers through several surfaces
failure_condition: Portfolio complexity masks weak products or all channels depend on the same search traffic
transfer_to_recommended_business: Build email saved projects and machine-readable evidence beside search from launch

evidence: Category-specific new used and vintage inventory persists through a parent sale with a visible seller fee
why_it_compounds: Focused supply and community language stay useful across ownership cycles
failure_condition: Transaction trust weakens or general marketplaces reach equal category liquidity
transfer_to_recommended_business: Own the specialist decision vocabulary before contemplating checkout

evidence: Correct product-page identity and held payment reduce card variant and counterparty risk
why_it_compounds: More exact listings and successful transactions reinforce liquidity
failure_condition: Counterfeit dispute and payment cost exceed marketplace fee
transfer_to_recommended_business: Identity and trust controls matter more than prose in used specialist markets

evidence: Project discovery feeds a paid professional operating product while commerce operations sit with a licensee
why_it_compounds: Supplier workflow can recur after a consumer project ends
failure_condition: Professional software is unrelated to lead quality or supplier retention
transfer_to_recommended_business: The installed-garden opportunity may mature into quote and project workflow rather than owned retail

evidence: Products are bought at retail and tested in the field and lab under a category method
why_it_compounds: Comparisons improve as the calibration set and reviewer expertise accumulate
failure_condition: Affiliate revenue cannot fund the method or search attribution collapses
transfer_to_recommended_business: Use a bounded seasonal field protocol and record raw observations independently of articles

mechanism: Comparison embedded in a larger commerce system
evidence: Acquisition joined price comparison reviews and high-intent traffic to Klarna payments and shopping
why_it_compounds: Existing consumer distribution and checkout increase the utility of comparison data
failure_condition: Parent priorities subsume neutrality or discovery remains controlled by a gatekeeper
transfer_to_recommended_business: An eventual strategic buyer is more likely to value the decision graph and intent than page count
